proof_body:
by
    intro f a b hab hf
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    have huc := isCompact_Icc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hf
    have hL : 0 ≤ b - a := sub_nonneg.2 hab
    have hL1 : 0 < b - a + 1 := by linarith
    have hε' : 0 < ε / (b - a + 1) := div_pos hε hL1
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hu⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp huc _ hε'
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((b - a) / δ)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hn1 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h, h = (b - a) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hh]
    have hhn : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h = b - a := by rw [hh]; field_simp
    have hh0 : 0 ≤ h := by rw [hh]; exact div_nonneg hL hn1.le
    have hhδ : h < δ := by
      have h1 : (N : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have h2 : (b - a) / δ < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hδ] at h2
      rw [hh, div_lt_iff₀ hn1]
      linarith
    have hmem : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n + 1 → a + (k : ℝ) * h ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      intro k hk
      have h1 : (k : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hk
      have h2 : (k : ℝ) * h ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hh0
      have h3 : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * h := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hh0
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hsucc : ∀ k : ℕ, a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h = a + (k : ℝ) * h + h := by
      intro k
      push_cast
      ring
    have hsub : ∀ k : ℕ, k < n + 1 → Set.uIcc (a + (k : ℝ) * h) (a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) ⊆ Set.Icc a b := by
      intro k hk
      exact Set.OrdConnected.uIcc_subset inferInstance (hmem k hk.le) (hmem (k + 1) hk)
    have hint : ∀ k < n + 1, IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume (a + (k : ℝ) * h) (a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) := fun k hk =>
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (hf.mono (hsub k hk))
    have hsum := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals (a := fun k : ℕ => a + (k : ℝ) * h) hint
    have h0 : a + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h = a := by simp
    have hend : a + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h = b := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    simp only [h0, hend] at hsum
    have key : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |h * f (a + (k : ℝ) * h) - ∫ t in (a + (k : ℝ) * h)..(a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h), f t| ≤ ε / (b - a + 1) * h := by
      intro k hk
      have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have hI := hint k hk'
      have e1 : (∫ t in (a + (k : ℝ) * h)..(a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h), (f t - f (a + (k : ℝ) * h))) = (∫ t in (a + (k : ℝ) * h)..(a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h), f t) - h * f (a + (k : ℝ) * h) := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hI intervalIntegrable_const, intervalIntegral.integral_const, hsucc k, smul_eq_mul]
        ring_nf
      have e2 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a + (k : ℝ) * h) (b := a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h) (C := ε / (b - a + 1)) (f := fun t => f t - f (a + (k : ℝ) * h)) (by
        intro t ht
        rw [hsucc k, Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith)] at ht
        have hts : t ∈ Set.Icc a b := hsub k hk' (by
          rw [hsucc k, Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)]
          exact ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
        have hd : dist t (a + (k : ℝ) * h) < δ := by
          rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos (by linarith [ht.1])]
          linarith [ht.2]
        have := hu t hts _ (hmem k hk'.le) hd
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at this
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact this.le)
      rw [e1, Real.norm_eq_abs, hsucc k] at e2
      have e3 : |a + (k : ℝ) * h + h - (a + (k : ℝ) * h)| = h := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_nonneg hh0]
      rw [e3, abs_sub_comm, ← hsucc k] at e2
      exact e2
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← hsum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    calc _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), |h * f (a + (k : ℝ) * h) - ∫ t in (a + (k : ℝ) * h)..(a + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h), f t| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ε / (b - a + 1) * h := Finset.sum_le_sum key
      _ = ε / (b - a + 1) * (b - a) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast
        rw [← hhn]
        ring
      _ < ε := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hL1]
        nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f (a + (k : ℝ) * ((b - a) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)))) Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ x in a..b, f x))
